name: apex-fattn-process-source-unroll

input_contract.required_source_shape: current supplied mma-process-device.goose with 14 statically bounded loops

output.dispatch: process_tile dispatches exactly (ncols1==4&&np==2) and (ncols1==8&&np==1); all other uniform args fall through to the original generic body

unrolling.policy: each statically bounded loop is unrolled by emitting one uniform `if true { let induction:i32=(v as i32); <original body without step> }` block per iteration; the typed local shadows the induction variable so original expression typing is preserved; the init statement is emitted once and the final induction value is assigned after the blocks
dynamic_paths: runtime KV loop kb0<kb0_stop-1 remains verbatim
all if guards remain; no constant folding of guards

specialization.param_renaming: specialized signatures rename ncols1/np parameters to ncols1_abi/np_abi
specialization.typed_locals: specialized bodies declare let ncols1:i32=(nc as i32); let np:i32=(np as i32); shadowing the unused renamed parameters
specialization.no_body_expression_substitution: body expressions and comments are copied verbatim except for replaced static loops

preservation: operation order and exact FMA/arithmetic semantics unchanged
no arithmetic reassociation or guard loosening
all loads, stores, addresses, barriers and cp.async ordering remain in source order
raw helper extern calls (single-ISA adapters and real Goose iterate) are not replaced or rewritten
no generated C edits, no native math callbacks, no measured-time claims
each unrolled iteration is one lexical scope, so iteration-local declarations do not collide

arithmetic_eval.laziness: only the selected operator is evaluated; no eager cross-operator arithmetic

failure_modes: missing top-level fn process_tile or missing ncols1/np parameters
unterminated block or statement or tokenizer gap
static-looking loop with unrecognized step, control flow, or unexpected induction-variable write
induction variable redeclared inside its own static loop
unexpected count of statically bounded loops (self-check expects 14)
determinism: pure function of source; no global state, network, shell, or randomness
non_goals: does not compile, link, run CUDA, or claim performance or acceptance
does not change the public ABI or parent launch code
does not specialize runtime KV length or dynamic guards
